## UFSoft.UBF.MVC.Common.ApiComParms

```json
{
  "description": "查询类接口公共参数",
  "required": [
    "PageSize",
    "PageIndex",
    "EntityFullName",
    "ReturnFields"
  ],
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "PageSize": {
      "format": "int32",
      "description": "每页数量",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "PageIndex": {
      "format": "int32",
      "description": "页码",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "Orders": {
      "description": "排序参数,例如BusinessDate desc, DocNo",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "Filters": {
      "description": "条件参数",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/UFSoft.UBF.MVC.Common.CompositeCriterion"
      }
    },
    "EntityFullName": {
      "description": "实体完整名称",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ReturnFields": {
      "description": "返回字段集合",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "example": {
    "PageSize": 10,
    "PageIndex": 1,
    "Orders": "BusinessDate desc,DocNo asc",
    "Filters": [
      {
        "Filters": [],
        "Field": "POLines.ItemInfo.ItemCode",
        "Operator": "in",
        "Value": "0001yy,0708AAA",
        "Logic": "and"
      },
      {
        "Filters": [
          {
            "Field": "DocumentType.Code",
            "Operator": "like",
            "Value": "John%",
            "Logic": "and"
          },
          {
            "Field": "BusinessDate",
            "Operator": "lt",
            "Value": "2024-06-28",
            "Logic": "and"
          }
        ],
        "Logic": "or"
      }
    ],
    "EntityFullName": "UFIDA.U9.PM.PO.PurchaseOrder",
    "ReturnFields": [
      "DocNo",
      "BusinessDate",
      "DocumentType.Code",
      "DocumentType.Name",
      "POLines.DocLineNo",
      "POLines.PurQtyTU",
      "POLines.ItemInfo.ItemCode",
      "POLines.ItemInfo.ItemName"
    ]
  }
}
```

## UFSoft.UBF.MVC.Common.CompositeCriterion

```json
{
  "description": "组合条件",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "Filters": {
      "description": "组合条件",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/UFSoft.UBF.MVC.Common.Criterion"
      }
    },
    "Field": {
      "description": "字段名",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "Operator": {
      "description": "条件类型\r\n如\"eq\"代表等于, \"ne\"代表不等于, \"lt\"代表大于, \"gt\"代表小于\r\n\"le\"代表大于等于, \"ge\"代表小于等于, \"in\"代表在...之中, \"nin\"代表不在...之中, \"like\"代表模糊查询",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "Value": {
      "description": "条件值，如10",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "Logic": {
      "description": "连接类型，and或者or",
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```
